name: Cable Triceps Pushdown with EZ-Bar Attachment
instructions: Attach an EZ-bar handle to a high pulley and grasp it with an overhand grip.
Stand facing the machine with your upper arms close to your sides and elbows bent.
Extend your elbows to press the handle down, then return slowly without moving your upper arms.

name: One-Arm Cable Triceps Pushdown with Overhand Grip
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grasp it with one hand using an overhand grip.
Stand facing the machine and keep the working upper arm close to your side.
Extend the elbow to press the handle down, then return slowly and repeat on the other side.

name: Single-Leg Squat to a High Box
instructions: Stand in front of a stable high box with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Bend your supporting knee and hip to lower until your hips lightly touch the box.
Press through the supporting foot to stand, then repeat on the other side.
